## About these sources

All 13 district GP-reservation gazettes are held. Eight have
passed extraction, parsing, and validation; the other five remain acquired but
unparsed. Acquisition, text extraction/OCR, and parsing are separate stages.
`extract.py` retains usable embedded text, `ocr.py` re-reads scans from 300 DPI
renders, and the parser consumes only those retained artifacts. A newly held
PDF therefore cannot silently enter the published rows merely because its
hidden text contains something category-like.

The source layouts differ. Kurnool is a ruled GP-by-ward table with usable
embedded text. Several earlier districts require positional OCR; they do not
agree on column order, and Krishna itself puts the ward count on opposite sides
of the Sarpanch cell on adjacent pages. Where no line marks the boundary between
the mandal and panchayat, it is recovered from the order of the records.

Kadapa is read from retained word coordinates because the scan is skewed and
its hidden text order does not preserve the table. Its 807 GP rows and 50
mandals are checked against the three abstracts printed in the same gazette.
Pages 56–57 then supply a separate errata layer: all 41 `For` values must agree
with the original table before the `Read as` values are applied. Corrected rows
retain both printed values and the correction page.

Two consequences worth knowing before using this. `ocr_repaired` counts the
mends a row's category cell needed - a wrong mend looks exactly like a right
one, so those rows stay findable rather than being quietly trusted. And
Anantapur states each sarpanch seat twice, in two separately typeset proformas;
the file holds their deduplicated union, `printings` records how many
statements stood behind each row, and `printings_agree` records whether they
said the same thing.

## Provenance

Every row carries `source_path` and `source_page` — the document it was read from and the page within it. The documents are committed here, so any row can be checked against the page it came from without a network round trip. That mattered repeatedly: nearly every parser bug in this repository produced plausible wrong values rather than an error, and opening the page was the only way to settle it.

All 8 cited documents are present.

Inventory for this directory: 17 scan, 15 digital-text, 13 mixed, 12 other, 3 tabular, 1,243 pages total.

## Reproducing

```
make ap
```

Parses from the committed documents and rewrites the files above, then runs `src/local_elections/states/ap/validate.py`.

## What is checked

Every state runs a shared battery first — the seat key is unique, the reservation label agrees with the two fields it summarises, every `source_path` exists and every `source_page` falls inside its document. Then this state's own checks, which are the ones that catch silent corruption because they appeal to something outside the data:

- the complete 13-document official source manifest and file checksums
- Kurnool's complete GP serial sequence from 1 through 972
- Kadapa's printed 807-GP/50-mandal controls and all 41 errata rows
- each gazette's own FORMAT-I abstract, district by district
- agreement between the two proformas that state a seat twice
- the share of category cells that needed OCR repair


| Check | Appeals to | 2020 `gp_head` | 2020 `gp_ward` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alias_family_exclusive` | internal | &check; 0 | &check; 0 |
| `blank_share_within_tolerance` | declared | &check; | &check; |
| `caste_scheme_respected` | declared | &check; BC,NONE,SC,ST | &check; BC,NONE,SC,ST |
| `caste_share_vs_population` | external | &ndash; 0 | &ndash; 0 |
| `coverage_vs_published` | external | &ndash; 7368 | &ndash; 72653 |
| `label_agrees` | internal | &check; 0 | &check; 0 |
| `plausible_vs_registry` | external | &check; 55% | &ndash; |
| `provenance_resolves` | internal | &check; 0 | &check; 0 |
| `reservation_constant_within_seat` | internal | &ndash; | &ndash; |
| `rows_in_band` | declared | &check; 7368 | &check; 72653 |
| `seat_key_unique` | internal | &check; 0 | &check; 0 |
| `tier_local_maps_to_one_tier` | internal | &check; sarpanch | &check; ward |
| `winner_caste_is_not_the_seats` | internal | &ndash; 0 | &ndash; 0 |
| `women_share_by_block` | external | ! 332 of 676 blocks off | ! 147 of 670 blocks off |
| `women_share_vs_statute` | external | &check; 50.4% | &check; 49.4% |
| `year_constant` | internal | &check; 2020 | &check; 2020 |

&check; pass &nbsp; ! warn &nbsp; &cross; fail &nbsp; &ndash; skipped, meaning no rule is declared for that slice — which is not the same as passing.

Each check declares what it **appeals to**. Only an external appeal - a published total, a statutory share, a population - reliably catches silent corruption; an internal check confirms the file agrees with itself, which it does whether or not a category was misread.

Column meanings are in [../../DICTIONARY.md](../../DICTIONARY.md). Expectation violations across every state are triaged into [../expectations_report.csv](../expectations_report.csv).
